2. Look for the "Forgot Password" option and click on it.

4. After verifying your email, a password reset link will be sent to your inbox. It's possible that the email might end up in your spam or junk folder, so kindly check there as well.
5. Click on the password reset link and follow the instructions provided to create a new password for your user profile.

If you encounter any difficulties during the process or have any further questions, feel free to reach out to me. I'm here to assist you every step of the way, ensuring you regain access to your user profile seamlessly.
